question: Should Workboard itself enforce fail-closed proof and linked-pull-request completion rules for all existing cards, and what explicit accepted/legacy path should remain available to operators?
rationale: The implementation changes persistent completion semantics and the linked proposal leaves the enforcement owner, legacy behavior, and pull-request acceptance contract intentionally undecided.

options.title: Define a plugin-level compatibility contract
options.body: Keep the policy in Workboard but specify a typed operator acceptance or waiver path and legacy-card upgrade behavior before merging.

options.title: Limit the change to advisory diagnostics
options.body: Keep existing completion behavior and surface missing proof or unresolved links as diagnostics until a broader policy is approved.

options.title: Defer enforcement
options.body: Pause this branch and keep the canonical proposal open until maintainers select the permanent completion model.

recommendation.title: Define a plugin-level compatibility contract
recommendation.body: Keep the policy in Workboard but specify a typed operator acceptance or waiver path and legacy-card upgrade behavior before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical proposal and the implementation, so they can clarify the intended behavior while a current-main Workboard owner is identified.
